regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, keywords, and SI/DOI links
regions.finding: The actual article title and aggregate kinetic-resolution/[4+2]/isomerization claim were inspected. Although an SI link is printed, workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 Comprehensive Graphic Content central reaction arrow
regions.finding: This is a generic visual summary of the current reaction class: racemic allene-dienes under [Rh(C2H4)2Cl]2/(R,R)-Ph-BPE/AgSbF6 in EtOH at 45 °C give a bicyclic product and a conjugated diene. It is linked to the general-scheme record; experiment-specific rows occur later.

regions.region: page 1 Comprehensive Graphic Content lower product gallery
regions.finding: The lower structures preview synthetic products later reported in Scheme 4. They are not separate arrows or independently specified experiments on page 1.

unresolved: The page-1 graphic uses generic R groups and does not define experiment-specific scale or yields.
SI association is unestablished despite the publisher link.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1a biologically active compounds
regions.finding: Captan, captafol, serlopitant, and mitiglinide are motivating structures, not reactions of the current paper; no experiment records were fabricated.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1b-i chirality-transfer arrow
regions.finding: The arrow is explicitly cited prior work (reference 7) and is classified as a literature example, not a current-paper experiment.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1b-ii concept drawing
regions.finding: The racemic molecular-recognition drawing is a generic current-work concept and is represented as a general scheme without row-specific yields.

regions.region: page 2 Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–7, ligand drawings, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Seven distinct ligand-screening runs were retained with shared/footnoted scale, catalyst/ligand/silver loadings, EtOH volume, temperature/time, recovery, normal-product yield/ee, isomerized-product yield/ee, trace and dash markers, and the entry-7 47% NMR yield of 1a'.

regions.region: page 2 optimization prose below Table 1
regions.finding: The narrative describes the same seven rows and introduces Table 2; it is linked rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, and isolated masses.
Trace and dash values remain qualitative source markers.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 2 entries 1–9 and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Nine independent condition-optimization rows were retained with row catalyst/silver salt/solvent, scale/volume, 45 °C/3 h, recovery, 3a NMR yield/ee, and 1a' NMR yield. No-product rows remain numeric zero only where the table prints zero; ee dashes remain markers.

regions.region: page 3 upper-right Table 3 entries 1–14 and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Each table row contains two separately performed substrate-scope reactions using (R,R)- or (S,S)-Ph-BPE. Twenty-eight records retain R1/R2/R3 identities, row-specific scale/volume/temperature/time overrides, isolated yields, and HPLC ee values.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 1 ORTEP of (3aS,7aS,E)-3k
regions.finding: CCDC 1953833 characterizes Table 3 product 3k. The figure is not a new preparation and does not verify the machine structure encoding.

regions.region: page 3 lower mechanism discussion introducing Scheme 2
regions.finding: The prose maps to the Scheme 2 controls on page 4: ligand/no-ligand isomerization, racemic control, solvent rows, time points, enantiopure-substrate and EtOH-d6 experiments. No prose-only duplicates were created.

unresolved: Table 3 omits most atmospheres, workups, purifications, and isolated masses; only 3a has a detailed page-5 procedure.
Figure 1 crystallography does not certify a machine SMILES.
Several Scheme 2 yield bases are not explicitly printed.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2a ligand/no-ligand arrows
regions.finding: Three distinct 24 h controls were retained: no ligand gives 100% recovery of 2a; (R,R)-Ph-BPE gives 3a in 93% NMR yield/95% ee with 5% recovery; (S,S)-Ph-BPE gives 96% NMR yield/94% ee with 4% recovery.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2b racemic 2a arrow
regions.finding: A separate racemic-normal-product control gives 3a in 88% isolated yield and 8% ee after 24 h.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2c solvent table and footnotes
regions.finding: Four distinct THF/DCM/MeCN/dioxane rows were retained with exact 0.1 mmol/1 mL/shared catalyst conditions, 45 °C/3 h, recovery, 2a yield/ee, 3a yield, and 1a' yield.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2d kinetic table and footnotes
regions.finding: Four printed time points (0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 3.0 h) were retained separately with recovered-Sa-1a yield/ee and product-specific 2a/3a/1a' outcomes.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2e–f enantiopure and EtOH-d6 arrows
regions.finding: Four independent controls were retained: Sa/Ra substrates under standard EtOH conditions and Sa/Ra substrates in EtOH-d6, with all displayed product yields, ee and zero-deuterated-product outcome preserved.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 2g oxygen- and malonate-tethered arrows
regions.finding: Two separately conditioned failed experiments were retained: 1p at 45 °C/12 h and 1o at 60 °C/24 h both give no expected product and no recovery.

regions.region: page 4 lower prose introducing Scheme 3 and Scheme 4
regions.finding: Mechanistic interpretation is linked to the proposed-mechanism record; synthetic-application prose maps to the page-5 arrows and is not duplicated.

unresolved: Several Scheme 2 arrows say only standard conditions; absolute scale/solvent volume and yield basis remain missing where not footnoted.
The time-course source does not state whether rows are independent runs or aliquots.
Failure detection limits and mixture compositions are not reported.

regions.region: page 5 upper Scheme 3 proposed catalytic cycle
regions.finding: A–E, [RhL*]+ and Rh-H paths are explicitly proposed intermediates/processes, not isolated preparations; they are represented as one mechanism record.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 4a double-epoxidation arrow and four products
regions.finding: Four substrate applications (4a/4c/4f/4h) were retained separately under 2.6 equiv mCPBA and NaHCO3 in DCM/H2O 1:1 at 0 °C for 24 h, with 61/65/56/58% yields and dr >20:1.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 4b OsO4/NMO/TsNH2 arrow
regions.finding: One bishydroxylation experiment gives the two product-specific outcomes 5a 50% and 6a 25% at 0 °C/12 h.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 4b DMP and TsOH branches
regions.finding: Two separate follow-up experiments were retained: DMP oxidation converts 6a to 7a quantitatively while 5a is recovered 61%; TsOH/acetone gives 8a quantitatively and 9a in 60%, with dr >20:1 values targeted to their products.

regions.region: page 5 detailed asymmetric synthesis of (3aS,7aS,E)-3a
regions.finding: The detailed 1.0 mmol experiment was merged into Table 3 entry 4 (R,R): exact charges, two 2.5 mL EtOH portions, glovebox/argon operations, room-temperature 10 min preactivation, 45 °C/3 h hold, workup, gradient chromatography, 133.1 mg/37%, and >99% ee/HPLC conditions were added.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits absolute scales, solvent volumes, workups, isolated masses, and several yield bases.
The detailed 3a procedure omits substrate-addition time and cooling duration.
CCDC 1953831/1953832 are characterization, not SI association or machine-structure verification.

regions.region: page 6 upper-left continuation of 3a characterization
regions.finding: NMR, IR, MS and HRMS complete the page-5 detailed 3a experiment; no second preparation or outcome is introduced.

regions.region: page 6 Supporting Information statement
regions.finding: The article says SI is available online, but no SI file is explicitly associated in source_mapping.json; no SI facts were inferred or imported.

regions.region: page 6 acknowledgment
regions.finding: Feng Jiang is thanked for reproducing results for 3h, 3l and (3aR,7aR,E)-3n. Because no independent charges, conditions, outcomes, or run identifiers are supplied, the statement is provenance on existing Table 3 records and creates no duplicate experiments.

regions.region: page 6 references 1–8
regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature citations only; external papers were not expanded into current-paper experiments.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
Characterization does not verify machine SMILES or semantic accuracy.
